title: Brighton Hotel Deals: Sea Views, the Lanes & Pier
description: Compare Brighton hotel prices on every big booking site. Seafront hotels with sea views, boutique stays near the Lanes, plus tips for summer weekends.
intro: Pier, pebbles and independent shops: compare Brighton hotel prices for your dates on every site.

sections.html: Sea-view rooms on the seafront usually cost more than rooms at the back or in the streets behind. Check the exact room type when you compare, so you know whether you’re looking at a sea view. Summer weekends and bank holidays are the busiest times.

faqs.q: Is Brighton a good day trip or weekend break from London?
faqs.a: Both. Direct trains from London take around an hour, so it’s easy as a day trip, but staying lets you enjoy the seafront in the evening. See also our seaside hotels page.
